svg.title: content program
svg.desc: A pencil at an angle, its eraser parted from its body, cut from a purple-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md): solid fills, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16. Proposed with the program; the program is not yet adopted.
